graph.description: One connected, acyclic vision graph. Output references must resolve to compatible ports on nodes in this graph. The host binds source media separately.

items.description: A typed node from node_contracts; its type selects its fields and ports.

nodes.description: Include exactly one frame_sample source and one to four detector/reader nodes. Connect each image operation to inference. References use $node_id.port and must match the source port's type. At most one detect, zone_filter, count_per_zone and rule node. An event sink is optional for plain reader/detection/count output.

image.description: Reference to an image output of another graph node, never a media ID or filename. Use the upstream node's exact output port.

barcode.description: Decode supported machine-readable codes in the input image. Ordinary printed text requires a text reader. Decoded text is included in preview output without an event sink.

count_per_zone.description: Aggregate detections into counts by region; consumes the final zone-filtered detections when a zone filter is present.

image.description: Reference to an image output of another node: $node_id.port.

box.description: Normalized [left, top, right, bottom] with positive area within [0,1].

crop.description: Extract a static rectangular region before inference. The box is relative to this node's input image, not necessarily the original source. This does not locate objects dynamically.

image.description: Reference to an image output of another graph node, never a media ID or filename. Use the upstream node's exact output port.

detect.description: Run the selected detector on the input image and return detections for the requested supported classes.

frame_sample.description: The graph's single source. The host supplies selected media; no path or media ID belongs in a node reference. Its frame output has image type.

match.description: Compare text readings with a fixed expected string and produce match events. This does not filter or replace the original text readings in preview output.

image.description: Reference to an image output of another graph node, never a media ID or filename. Use the upstream node's exact output port.

ocr.description: Read all detected text in the input image. This node does not semantically select a requested field or discard unrelated text. Its text readings are included in preview output without requiring an event sink.

image.description: Reference to an image output of another node: $node_id.port.

resize.description: Resize an image to the given pixel dimensions before downstream inference.

rule.description: Test counts against a threshold and produce an event. Connect its event output to a sink_event node. Count-only applications do not need a rule.

event.description: Reference to an event output: $node_id.event; never a text, image or detections output.

sink_event.description: Receive an event produced by match or rule. Text is not an event. Optional for plain detection, counting or reading output; investigation previews never dispatch external events.

zone_filter.description: Filter detections using the project's already confirmed region geometry.
